summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Admin feed toggle and redesigned feed page. All 12 backend API tests passed. All frontend tests passed including admin feed toggle UX, feed page full-screen layout, VIDEO PREVIEW indicator, PLAY NOW navigation, Save/Share buttons, and Eye/EyeOff visibility toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: 'Explore only' badge text in GamesTab.tsx shows as 'Exploreonly' (no visible space) in some viewport sizes - visually looks concatenated. Consider adding a CSS word-break or verifying font rendering.

Minor: After admin login, user is redirected to /profile instead of /admin. The admin URL navigation works when visited directly but login redirect could be improved to return user to original destination.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing 'Cat Evolution' game (id: 08e2830f-d4d0-45bf-9062-b0aabc441d79). Game restored to show_in_feed=True and is_visible=True after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features fully verified: (1) Admin feed toggle button (TvMinimalPlay lime / Tv orange) works correctly with proper toasts ('Game moved to Explore only' / 'Game added to Feed') and 'Explore only' badge. (2) Feed page fully redesigned - full-screen black layout, VIDEO PREVIEW indicator, Cat Evolution title visible, PLAY NOW button works and navigates to /play/[id], Save/Share buttons on right side. Backend: GET /api/games correctly filters by show_in_feed=True. PATCH /api/admin/games/{id}/feed-visibility endpoint works with auth. Eye/EyeOff toggle (is_visible) still works independently of feed toggle.
